notes.title: User Interface Design Improvements, Casino Demand Info, and Critical Fixes
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thanks for giving us your valuable feedback, we have a pretty substantial update for you all today!

[h2]New Logo![/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38173103/531f1c95ec76b89cebbdbd6e3cab47efcab79ece.png[/img]

We decided to go for a simpler logo design with a new red tone!

[h2]User Interface Design[/h2]

[h3]Lower HUD[/h3]
We're proud to present a number of user interface clean-up improvements, with additional changes to make the colors more appealing and modern looking as well.

We have reworked the overall layout of the HUD to make the buttons and text stand out more. This takes more advantage of the horizontal space available, and should make certain icons, buttons, and error notifications easier to see.

[h3]NEW VERSION:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38173103/523892b29126455eac90806417afb469d3896ef2.png[/img]

[h3]OLD VERSION:[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38173103/3c20ece19fdd4678ca22f9a42cfdfc063ae48b98.png[/img]

[h3]Management Window[/h3]
This also comes with some tweaks to the "white space" of the management window, which adds more space and makes certain buttons bigger and easier to find.

[h2]Reporting Data[/h2]

[h3]Finance Window[/h3]
The finance window now compares the current selected day to the previous day, making it much easier to see trends!

[h3]Guest and Gambling Statistics[/h3]
"Average need level", from the guest need screen, has been renamed to "average satisfaction" for clarity. In other words, it is now obvious that a high value is a good thing, not a bad thing.

Some of the formatting for the headings and statistics have been cleaned up.

[h3]Demographic Demand Bars[/h3]
The arrows for the demands have been replaced with bars. These now show the demands of each demographic relative to the other, and they update throughout the day.

For example, a casino that attracts 100 gamblers and 20 executives at night will show 100% gambling and 20% executives (the demographic with the most is always the highest value). Then, during the day when only 10 gamblers are attracted and 200 executives want to do business then the bars will show 5% gamblers and 100% executives.

[b]BONUS:[/b] Clicking on the demand bars now takes you directly to the demographics & marketing window for quick access to all of the details!

[h3]Community Translations[/h3]
Lastly, we updated all submitted community translations.

[h2]The fixes![/h2]

[h3]Instant Research Is Finally Instant![/h3]
An important change to make research less confusing to players: if you have instant research enabled, then all research is automatically completed at the start. You no longer have to manually trigger each one for free.

[h3]Measuring Tool[/h3]
The measuring text when using the construction tool no longer hides behind objects, and this works for all languages!

[h3]Stuck Guests and Slowdown[/h3]
We've fixed the strange behaviour caused by guests not being able to find their way out of the casino. Sometimes this caused them to get stuck, and for other times they got lost or went down strange paths.

This could even cause slowdown depending on how frequently the game was reporting errors.

[h3]Thieves Not Getting Caught[/h3]
Similar to the above issue, criminals will now correctly find their way to the exit and this allows guards to plan their attack. Without this info, guards were getting confused about what to do (and causing slowdown errors too!)

notes.title: Gambling Data Improvements Update - December 12th 2021
notes.content:
As we teased in our last update, tonight's patch contains the new Gambling Report - an extensive report sheet found under Attractions which aggregates some existing data & also includes new data that is now tracked for all your slot machines and table games. We hope this new data will help everyone get slot machines on track to make the most profit!

Additionally, this patch contains fixes for the 'gambling confidence' ranges for low denomination slot machines & table games, and general adjustments for all gambling related objects for better overall balance.  After these changes the result will be similar to how it was before the last patch, but agents will generally begin with a higher initial confidence rating.  This allows new players at your casino to play more games, including most $1 slot machines.

Overall, these most recent changes (including the prior update) should make life MUCH easier in terms of making money with slot machines, and provide you the tools you need to understand how your casino floor is making money via the new reporting screen.

Be sure to let us know how you like the new Gambling Report -- on the Steam Forums or our [url=https://discord.gg/py29nCw]Discord [/url] Server!  :)


As always, thanks to everyone helping out on the edge branch to test these patches -- it's what allows us to rapidly iterate & deliver -- thank you!

notes.title: Full Release Out Now! Livestreams! Game Update!
notes.content:
[h2]We've Left Early Access![/h2]

...But it's not all over! We still want to make this game better, and of course we will still respond to bug reports, we just hope that we do not need to! A [i][b]big thankyou[/b][/i] to all of you for helping us make this the best game possible, and for testing and reporting issues.

We're also planning a future update for our previous game, SimAirport, and we will be (likely) talking about it in one of the livestreams!

[h2]Livestreams[/h2]

We're planning a few livestreams this week so you can get to talk to the developers and watch us play!

[b][u]When[/u][/b]
Wednesday 17th, Thursday 18th, & Saturday 20th
7pm BST / 8pm CEST / 11am PDT!

For all three dates, they should start at the same time. We will let you know if that changes - keep an eye on our twitter and discord!

[b][u]Where?[/u][/b]
[url=https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCJunrUINTXrIJuO8_zPtd6A]YouTube[/url], [url=https://www.twitch.tv/lvgamedev]Twitch[/url], and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1158420/SimCasino/]Steam[/url]

[h2]15th November Update[/h2]
We have set the game assets to uncompressed. This will result in a much larger file size for the installation, but it should fix cases where Steam gets confused about what files were updated. It can also improve loading times in some cases.

[list][b]Improvements[/b]
[*]Neighbor casino income updates every hour instead of daily and includes both cash and card payments (similar to the cash distribution screen). We recommend letting time pass on each map to improve the accuracy of their income.
[*]Security can now look out for criminals while doing restock tasks. They will alert other guards in the process but not chase them - in a future update when we do more testing we want to allow them to start chasing if they can.
[*]Admin, such as research and pit boss staff, now sit at desks!

[b]UI[/b]
[*]Starter map preview is bigger in the new profile screen and a random one is selected by default.
[*]Clone tool allows cloning an area even if some of the objects cannot be - they will be skipped. This does not work for certain wall object situations.
[*]Clone tool toggle all button works like demolish the tool and ignores two level option.
[*]Fix eye dropper prioritizing wallpaper over wall objects.
[*]Hovering over a hotel room now highlights the full connected areas.
[*]Allow buttons to be interactable while viewing overlays.
[*]New icon for toggle zones.
[*]New button for toggle measurements.
[*]Stolen money is counted towards estimated expenses in distribution screen.
[*]Fix error when closing bar UI window.
[*]Fix zoom center on mouse not always setting on launch.
[*]Fix error in construction helper visual.
[*]Fix a number of UI elements sometimes responding to key presses unintentionally. One example is the keys becoming unresponsive when using the patrol editor.
[*]Hide build dates in game.
[*]Remove Hebrew from the game. We cannot support right-to-left languages.
[*]German is fully translated.
[*]Updated community translations.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[*]Guests only play in bingo halls they bought cards from.
[*]No longer incorrectly count a bunch of sports bets as uncollected prizes.
[*]Fix rare case where a sports betting customer gets stuck at a closed cashier window.
[*]Fix poker table minimum players resetting.
[*]Fix shows being cancelled when theatre stage is moved.
[*]Fix queue sometimes going into the air, causing stuck guests.
[*]Fix rare case where kitchen equipment no longer functions.
[*]Autosave no longer happens with control S during first person mode - fixes getting stuck in that mode.
[/list]

[h2]Mac Support[/h2]
We are very sorry to have to announce this, but we have had to come to the difficult decision of no longer officially supporting the Mac version. It has been a challenge over the last year to get the game to run on as well as we intended across all versions.

The Mac versions of the game will still remain up so that they can still be downloaded and played, and we know from our own experience that it can work on both Intel and M1 versions, [b]but with issues[/b]. It's also important to note that future updates of the game will still include "builds" (or playable versions) for Mac - we're not just going to drop it or completely remove it.

[b]In other words: we are simply no longer advertising the Mac version, but we will still keep updating it with improvements from the Windows version and allowing people to play it.[/b]

As a side note, we also do not officially support Linux, however, it apparently works well with Proton.

Just a note that we'll be having a stream sometime next week, so keep an eye out for more updates early next week! We're planning to launch in the near future, it's exciting for all of us here at LVGameDev!

[h2]Changelog[/h2]
[list][b]Guest Improvements[/b]
[*]Slow down bladder and hunger need a bit.
[*]Reduce starting confidence for rich guests a bit.
[*]Increase how thirsty some guests are when arriving.
[*]Increase the rate at which guests get thirsty.
[*]Reduce max stay hours for guests.
[*]Guests are much less sensitive to constantly converting tickets and chips, but are much more likely to do it when leaving.
[*]Convention hall runners no longer leave the casino mid convention, and they better prioritize their other needs.

notes.title: 30th September Big Update!
notes.content:
[list][h2][u]Modding[/u][/h2]
[url=https://github.com/lvgamedev/simcasino-modding/wiki]Modding Wiki[/url]
You can now import your own custom 3D models in the game! Setting up the objects is fairly advanced, so please visit the wiki above and our modding discussion on discord as normal.

Do note: [b]the wiki is under construction, so we recommend that you start on learning a tool like Blender, then modelling and texturing the objects[/b] as that can be time consuming. We should have a helpful and detailed wiki in the next 24 hours, which will help you import them into the game. The file format is gltf v2 when exporting.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]Add system for mods to save settings/state on a profile level.
[*]Add event for mods to use when game state is changed.
[*]Allow many more custom slot machine video and tv station videos to be played. Let us know if you have any issues with VRAM! There is still a hard coded limit, but it is much higher now.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*]Fix mod uploader for custom textures not working.
[*]Upload casino to workshop works now!
[*]Fix error when the sprite file went missing in the mod editor.

[h2][u]Enhanced Guests[/u][/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]Added many new updated animations! This includes new guest slot machine animations, guest table game animations, and idle animations.
[*]Guests with good table game skills are more likely to play there.
[*]Environment need is much more reactive to the nearby area.
[*]Lodgers have a higher chance of spawning as a group compared to other guest types.
[*]Gamblers get an additional gambling boost over time.
[*]Drunk and tipsy guests break things quicker.
[*]Sleeping removes drunkness. Drunk guests get sleepy faster.
[*]Adjustments to improve chances of getting hotel groups.
[*]Guests sleep longer and get less tired in the day.
[*]Move morning hunger time from 8am to 7am.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*]Fix needs that are supposed to take longer to increase being quicker than shorter ones.
[*]Fix guests queuing for box office to buy seats that are not available.
[*]Customers no longer leave the map immediately after the long walk through the city.
[*]Fix friends not being able to access hotel rooms.
[*]Fix women's sleeping position.
[*]Fix leaving group members keeping bedrooms but not allowing others to un-reserve them. You may have to rezone these rooms.
[*]Fix hunger not increasing in the morning.
[*]Fix some hotel entertainment objects bringing in the wrong guest types.
[*]Fix some hotel guests never paying for their rooms.
[*]Fix dance floors not increasing entertainment customers.
[*]Fix not enough meeting execs spawning.
[*]Fix guests sometimes instantly using (and finishing) an object, such as instantly using a computer desk if someone else beat them to it!
[*]Fix guest's "recent thoughts" not resetting when they leave the casino and a new guest inherits them!
[*]Fix queue time not resetting and being inherited by a new guest also!
[*]Fix a couple of cases where guests leave their rooms without getting dressed.
[*]Guests getting out of the hot tub attempt to go to the wardrobe to get dressed instead of on the spot.
[*]Fix guests sometimes walking through roulette and craps tables.
[*]Fix performers sometimes ignoring dressing rooms with a matching rating.

[h2][u]Security[/u][/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]Build an interrogation room with a new desk and one way window! Caught criminals no longer fight if there's a room available, instead they will be taken to the room and watched by a guard through the window. Then, the guard will interview them until the criminal breaks down. You'll see a temporary drop in crimes after that.
[*]Guards can call for backup if health is low.
[*]Guards heal themselves in a security zone now, not just on the spot.
[*]Multiple small improvements to the way guards chase criminals.
[*]Security guards and pit bosses can now check for thieves, hackers, and cheaters. Before, each was more specialized to a particular type.
[*]Reduce the effectiveness of cheaters at table games where they have a low skill at.
[*]Guards now take the recovered stolen cash to the vault instead of directly into the bank account.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*]Count failed cheat attempts towards stolen amount. In other words, cheaters have always been able to lose money, but this was never subtracted from the stolen amount.
[*]Fix camera booths functioning without valid zone.
[*]Fix camera overlay not refreshing when guards arrive.
[*]Fix cameras not being created correctly.
[*]Show warning error over the cameras, not on the floor.
[*]Fix thieves going to the wrong location to steal things.
[*]Fix thieves not being able to select any location in some cases.
[*]Fix cheaters sometimes never being chased and never getting caught.
[*]Fix some crimes not being reported.
[*]Fix stolen amount showing as income.
[*]Fix security being slow to respond to seeing criminals.
[*]Fix thieves never being able to break down doors.
[*]Fix thieves not attempting to steal directly from vault.
[*]Fix arrested criminals sometimes getting stuck in staff areas.
[*]Staff doors animate open for arrested criminals.
[*]Fix thieves getting stuck at doors as they are being repaired.

[h2][u]UI[/u][/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]We decided to clean up and simplify the schedule editor! The redundant visual editor is removed so that there's only one editor instead of two, the awkward "add row" pop-up window is gone, and the layout and colors have been cleaned up.
[*]Changes you make in the schedule editor update the schedule as you make changes. No more apply changes button.
[*]Schedule options auto-sort when you insert a new time. This makes it more intuitive to read.
[*]Time texts say midnight and noon where necessary.
[*]Beer icon for drinks servers instead of a cash register.
[*]New warning in the patrols screen that you need to zone more pitboss offices.
[*]New color for buttons.
[*]Tell player when workshop icon is missing.
[*]Staff on patrol show the patrol name they are doing when hovered over.
[*]Added Hungarian language option.
[*]Update community translations.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*]Poker tables only count their commission made as income, and no longer count the rake as income and prizes given out. This only affects new stats.
[*]Fix wall tool not allowing partial drags over fences and other walls.
[*]Fix slot market screen missing modded games.
[*]Fix wrong wall/fence cost reported.
[*]Removing walls and fences no longer charges the player.
[*]Do not show "cannot convert more stock" on certain objects where it doesn't make sense to.
[*]Fix staff screen button not flashing during tutorial.
[*]Fix text sometimes disappearing on flashing buttons.
[*]Fix green selection box getting stuck when hovering over the UI.
[*]Fix tutorial window background disappearing.
[*]Fix inventory contents not showing for sports book.
[*]Fix door strength text not being translated.

[h2][u]Other[/u][/h2]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]Staff wages are more realistic and much lower.
[*]Cashier cages have a much cash greater capacity compared to cashier windows.
[*]Make bus stop and taxi signs bigger.
[*]Pictures can be placed outside.
[h3]Fixes[/h3]
[*]Fix many objects failing to load correctly, and other side effect bugs.
[*]Fix stuck housekeeping when the target dropoff zone for bed sheets is not accessible.
[*]Fix upper levels for first person mode not rendering correctly sometimes.
[*]Fix buying workshop plot when not researched multiple casinos.
[*]Fix bed sheets getting dirty after one person gets out of bed.
[*]Fix a number of objects poking through the ceiling.
[*]Fix camera not resetting properly after exiting first person.
[*]Fix objects not attaching to walls when they looked like they should.
[*]Fix table game refunds after a dispute sometimes being incorrect.
[*]Fix slot machine not boosting slots in jackpot event.
[*]Fix staff sometimes not following their schedules.
[*]Stop janitors taking dirty bed sheets to and from washing machines constantly!
[*]Stop adding 0.3 bed sheets to laundry!
[*]Fix some errors with theater seating.
[*]Fix some doors playing the wrong sound effects.
[*]Boost a bunch of unheard sound effects.
[*]Fix tv screens not playing videos outside.
[*]Fix elevator cars sometimes missing guests or going to wrong floors.
[*]Fix zone staff wages being reported as income. You might want to rezone these ones to get new stats.
[*]Fix blocked areas being left behind when removing a wall with a door on it. It always fixes on reload.
[*]Fix some restock tasks not requiring staff to walk to them!
[*]Fix repair object tasks not requiring staff to approach them.
[*]Fix coffee table 3 being a bit too big.
[/list]

notes.title: September 3rd 2021 Update
notes.content:
Firstly, please note that we have added a [i][b]harmless[/b][/i] warning message for games last saved prior to September. We're still in early access, but we're drawing the line here for "old saves". They can still be played - it's mostly to make players more aware about potentially reporting out of date issues. We will still respond to issues reported on these saves - they aren't "unsupported".

The reality of it is, once we do launch there will be a lot of players who haven't played in months that, all at the same time, will be loading their old saves from nearly a year ago and expecting them to run smoothly.

We are close to exiting early access, and we originally wanted to put a warning on all early access saves but felt like the ones made recently will probably be OK from after now - and we had to draw a line somewhere. Of course, you are absolutely free to ignore the warning.

[list][h3]Theatre Improvements[/h3]
[*]Dressing rooms now have a room rating. Actors now have a minimum room rating requirement based on the show they are performing in. You will get a notification if an actor cannot find a room with a high enough score.
[*]Dressing room no longer requires enclosed space.
[*]You can now sort theatre shows by name, rating, cast size, and type.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]Big re-balance of all needs. Needs should rise slower, and guests should generally be more satisfied, and less quickly to spike with multiple poor needs.
[*]Service objects like buffets attract more guests. Large casinos signs have a greater boost.
[*]Frustration and satisfaction effects from prices is now much smoother with a broader range. You can now set prices much lower and still get the benefits, before guests would not be any happier with a 10% discount vs a free product. You may have to adjust your prices.
[*]Bars and dance floors have higher social attraction for guests.
[*]Add grouped object zone. Basically allows you to group multiple objects together to see their financial stats. Does not affect the guests.
[*]You can now research double capacity elevators!
[*]Guests will arrive hungry at meal times.
[*]Guests with food, drink, or alcohol get a bladder increase by 2x.
[*]Adjust logic for how groups of guests choose where to go.
[*]Guests are a bit smarter about not choosing objects they don't need to use.
[*]Allow higher bingo play costs and much higher prizes. The bingo satisfaction calculation has been improved.
[*]Click on a security camera to automatically bring up the camera overlay.
[*]Wall objects can now be cloned without cloning walls too.
[*]Basic blocky outline of neighboring casinos can be seen in the world and casino views. You will have to load and save prior casinos to see them appear.

[h3]UI[/h3]
[*]Add debug mode console command for mod testing.
[*]Add force animation dropdown to test custom slot machine videos.
[*]Add confirmation menu to show mods are reloading when finished downloading from the missing screen.
[*]You can now click directly on zones and objects to assign or unassign them instead of having to click the dialogs. The dialogs have been made easier to see.
[*]You can now apply a custom scaling to the build menu buttons.
[*]Center position of the overlay button in the lower HUD.
[*]Reduce edge scroll delay significantly when hovered over UI.
[*]Zones now toggle off when using the floor tool.
[*]Show verify game files message if assets do not load.
[*]If the casino is closed for a while, show a notification to prompt the player to open.
[*]Improve the way that the price satisfaction percent is displayed. Also reduce the amount of info.
[*]Show the charge per table when clicking on the convention hall.
[*]No more holding down the move button - simply tap the custom keybinding over an object to go directly into move mode.
[*]After dragging the cursor, you can now directly click Clone Tool to clone that area of objects.
[*]Notification popups about customers now select the customer when you click on them.
[*]Hold down shift while using the build wall or fence tool to remove walls and fences.
[*]Added new restroom category to the build menu to make it easier to find.
[*]Updated community translation files.

[h3]UI Bugs[/h3]
[*]Fix the camera moving to the garbage zone in the patrol screen.
[*]Fixed wall tool and clone tool allowing walls being placed in fences and vice versa.
[*]Fix clicking Manage Game on bingo hall going to the wrong screen.
[*]Fix missing mods window not scrolling.
[*]Invert tilt and mouse rotation now work in first person mode.
[*]Fix convention halls and computer rooms showing the wrong room rating value.
[*]Fix sorted hotel and show lists missing the last item to sort.
[*]Fix some object selection issues on upper floors.
[*]Also fix not being able to select guests and staff properly.
[*]Fix wrong icon showing for clear walls.
[*]Fix ventilation error showing for zero ventilation.
[*]Fix the HUD showing in first person mode when pressing the toggle user interface key.
[*]Fix an error after duplicating a slot machine.
[*]Don't show Unlink Jackpots for slot machines that don't have jackpots linked.

[h3]AI Bugs[/h3]
[*]Fix retail servers getting stuck trying to go to guests they cannot serve.
[*]Retail workers no longer hang around guests when all of the bars run out of stock.
[*]Fix patrol workers not choosing the correct bar to back to.
[*]Fix bingo satisfaction being very inconsistent and non-logical. Also fixes it for not affecting guests when they buy tickets.
[*]Fix hand sanitizers not being used causing no gym usage.
[*]Fix hand sanitizers outside of gyms not being used.
[*]Fix staff doing distracting jobs instead of manning stations.
[*]Fix frequent error in staff AI decisions.
[*]Fix executives never turning up for meetings. Some legacy meetings will be automatically cancelled on load to avoid further problems.
[*]Fix stuck theater performers.
[*]Fix wetbar and dance club tasks not taking into account game speed.
[*]Drunk levels also now take into account game speed.
[*]Fix drunk level not resetting between guests leaving and arriving. Overtime, lots of drunk guests would gradually appear.
[*]Fix guests crowding hand sanitizers when there is no gym.
[*]Fix stuck guest when casino is closed.
[*]Fix stuck worker trying to move a crate.
[*]Fix error in agent group logic.
[*]Fix two errors causing frozen staff across the map.
[*]Fix some errors in the bar task.

[h3]Mod Bugs[/h3]
[*]Disable reloading of slot games (new ones are still loaded fine) to prevent issues with videos going missing.
[*]Fix missing floors when a modded floor cannot be loaded.

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[*]Fix table game bets not copying or cloning.
[*]Financial stats are copied over when object is moved.

notes.title: August 20, 2021 Major Update
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, everyone![/h2]
Thanks to everyone for being patient! We've got a fantastic update for you all today.

[h2]Updates![/h2]

[list][h3]First Person Mode[/h3]
We have added a new first person mode, where you can walk around as a staff member or guest to get a better look at your casino! It's a great way to show off your casino in videos and with screenshots! The stairs, escalators, and elevators are quite fun to ride!

[h3]Mod Support![/h3]
Want to make the ultimate casino of your dreams that is completely customized? You got it!

[*]Custom slot machine games and videos!
[*]Custom TV stations!
[*]Custom floor and wall textures!
[*]Custom pictures!
[*]Custom code! Literally rewrite the game!

We even added the ability to add new textures directly in the game mode! We have a simple mod editor window to do so! We are working on adding custom 3D models in the future.

[b]There are already mods ready to try! [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1158420/workshop/]Workshop[/url][/b]

[b]Check out our [url=https://github.com/lvgamedev/simcasino-modding/wiki]Modding Wiki[/url][/b]!

[b]Any questions about mods? Please discuss them here: [url=https://discord.com/channels/758808497444880437/831620641333575723]Discord[/url][/b]

[h3]Improved Guests![/h3]
[*]Guests can now arrive in couples, and will generally visit the same objects and can socialize at different points in the casino with new talking animations.
[*]Couples can book hotel rooms and share the larger beds!
[*]After a meeting, executives get a random chance of boosted gambling, entertainment, or exercise desire.
[*]Guests more likely want to gamble if they get money from ATM, Cashier cage, or Sportsbook.
[*]Added new holding-bladder idle and running animations for when your guests are desperate!
[*]Guests can get drunk and tipsy! Tipsy guests gain confidence much faster, while drunk guests will need to head home and are more likely to drop litter.
[*]Added new drunk idle animation.
[*]AI need tweaks to make hunger and bladder slower. Frustration is quicker to fall.
[*]Guests will look sad when they are not having a good time.
[*]Tweak drink and snack prices to give a more balanced and realistic profit margin and a more fair effect on the guest's satisfaction.

[h3]More Attractions![/h3]
[*]Added a new convention hall zone with new convention tables, fence type, and poster stand! Conventions are automatically scheduled, and the price they pay is based on the room rating. They attract a lot of new executives to your Casino.
[*]Create a VIP Bedroom and use the marketing screen to book a celebrity to stay in your casino! They are a great way to boost the number of guests in your casino. They will require a 5 star room! They normally arrive after midday.
[*]VIPs can leave if annoyed or unsatisfied, and this leaves a negative impact on your casino's demand.
[*]Added a new dance hall zone! Enhance it with new speakers and hanging lights! Guests will want a drink first before using it.

[h3]Performance[/h3]
[*]Improve indoor lighting performance.
[*]Reduce overhead of the agent AI processing.

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]New floor patterns!
[*]You can now choose from a collection of curated casinos to start a new profile from in the main menu. Add your own saves to the Streaming Assets / Prebuilt Casinos folder.
[*]New table booths for buffets!
[*]Gyms and conference rooms also have a room rating now, and that too affects the price and price satisfaction. You can still set prices for these.
[*]New research items for the new features.
[*]Increased research times of a few items.
[*]Adjusted the effects of the hotel rating scores.
[*]Laundry zone no longer requires an enclosed space, but still requires a staff only area.
[*]Adjustments to the visuals of some of the floors.
[*]The ground can no longer be removed - it is always the same grass. This helps keep the visual consistent instead of having a second grass design.

[h3]UI[/h3]
[*]Show undetected crimes in the crime screen after they have bragged online about it.
[*]Searching for a term that matches a tag (such as "laundry") now shows all objects with that tag.
[*]Added auto download feature for missing mods.
[*]Added file browser window to the mod editor.
[*]Conference Room now fails and shows an error if missing a conference table.
[*]New construction category for bedroom entertainment for hotels.
[*]Increase the area for the time of day text to reduce the chances of it going onto two lines.
[*]Guests and staff are much easier to click on when they are within an area of objects. Crates and trash bags also get higher priority.
[*]Zones not meeting requirements error now shows how many zones have failed.
[*]Show the floor where invalid zones are.
[*]Guests show a list of recent thoughts they had. We plan to show this per object at some point, and to add more thoughts.
[*]You can now set the hotel group with multiselect.
[*]Improve the appearance of highlighted zones.
[*]Updated community translations.

[h3]Dismantle Tool[/h3]
[*]Added an updated universal demolish tool. Remove everything from one place, with multi-select options! You can now remove an area of walls!
[*]The structure mode removes up to two floors at once, and you can disable two level to just remove the top floor of a two-level room.
[*]Press tab to switch between one-level and two-level.
[*]The other mode can be toggled to remove a lot of different things in various combinations.

[h3]New Hotkeys[/h3]
[*]New move hotkey added! It defaults to 'V' like in Photoshop (note that eyedropper is now defaulted to 'I', also like Photoshop).
[*]Hold down the move key and then select an object.
[*]Or, select multiple objects and then press the move key.
[*]Or, select an object and then press the move key in the menu.
[*]B is the default shortcut for the build menu, and I is the default for the eyedropper.
[*]Press Delete when using multiselect to delete all.

[h3]UI Bugs[/h3]
[*]Removed a duplicate keyboard shortcut for remove walls tool. If yours no longer works, it might have been assigned to the other one.
[*]Fix linked jackpot display dropdown showing the first jackpot assigned when not.
[*]Fix some loading tips getting skipped.
[*]Fix the shift-floor tool sometimes filling the wrong areas.
[*]Fix some zones not showing finance tabs due to an error.
[*]Fix wall preview mouse tool not showing the correct texture when trying out new colors.
[*]Selection boxes are removed if using escape.
[*]Dragging tools no longer deselect when hovering over the UI.

[h3]Bugs[/h3]
[*]Fix outdoor terrain looking bright at night because it was reacting to indoor light.
[*]Fix linked jackpots starting with too much money.
[*]Fix a case where a save wouldn't load due to an endless loop.
[*]Fix curtains being invisible in a certain direction.

[*]Fix symbol signs being too low.

[*]Fix flipped around textures on some wall sides.
[*]Hackers will hack slot machines with cash in them even if they don't like the game on it!
[*]Fix the height of the splashing water in the smaller fountain.
[*]Fix cloning a TV doesn't keep it's channel.

[*]Allow multiple security offices for camera booth stations.
[*]Added new pizza neon sign, pizza buffet, and pizza oven with research requirement.
[*]Price satisfaction at buffets is now affected by the variety of buffet bar options. Pizzas have a bonus variety score. Because of this, the maximum price for buffets has also increased.
[*]Customers and criminals can now spawn in and out of the casino via the city. They will walk (or run) along roads to various buildings. They will walk if the bus stop runs out of capacity.
[*]Marketing packages can be auto-renewed. They are automatically cancelled when you cannot afford them.
[*]Audio ambience and crowd sound effects have been re-balanced. It's likely you'll need to reduce the overall volume of ambience in the settings.
[*]Adjust hunger curve to encourage more frequent eating.

[*]Adjusted starting cash amount choices.

notes.title: June 18th 2021 Update
notes.content:
[h3]Translating the Game[/h3]
Please consider donating some time and help us bring this game to other communities around the world! Head over to the [url=https://www.localizor.com/simcasino]SimCasino page on Localizor.com[/url] if you'd like to help us!

[h3]June 18th 2021 Update[/h3]

[list][b]New Objects and Textures[/b]
[*]New ceiling light and neon strip lights!
[*]Two smaller neon arrow variants.
[*]New large casino sign for outside!
[*]Place all letters of the English alphabet as custom signs!
[*]Added a few new floor and wall textures.
[*]New chair! This can be placed anywhere or built as part of a desk or dining table.

[b]Guest and AI Improvements[/b]
[*]Guests no longer queue at table games, which should improve distribution.
[*]Sports events and theatre shows attract even more guests, and marketing events are much more effective.
[*]Remove population caps for all casinos!
[*]Hotel demand and sleep needs should only be high during the night. Note that existing guests may still have high sleep needs during the day on loading a save. This should improve guest distribution at attractions during the day.
[*]Boosted the general popularity of slot machine games even when the popularity of the game itself is low.

[b]Improvements[/b]
[*]Allow wall objects to be placed vertically between levels, rather than skipping floors. Should work on most wall objects. This only applies if there's no floor between.
[*]Allow "floating" inside floors with the floor removal tool. Useful for aesthetic reasons in some cases.
[*]Staff now walk faster when doing important jobs.
[*]New social media marketing! It's a bit more effective and cheaper than radio, but requires the advanced marketing research.
[*]Default garbage zone shift has been changed for the tutorial.
[*]New players cannot enable manual deliveries in new game setup.
[*]Update and tweak the build and staff tutorials.
[*]Guards on patrol no longer accept restocking tasks.

[b]UI[/b]
[*]Multiselect "tool" is now the default action. Simply click and drag anywhere to select multiple objects. Removed the button.
[*]The popularity of slot machine games is now reported at a more useful value. Before it displayed 0%-100% range, but in reality, it only affects the score at around 50%, so we now display values of 50%-100% range. In other words, slot machine games never truly have a 0% popularity.
[*]UI error icons are now animated.
[*]Replaced the "randomize slot machine games and odds" in multiselect with two new buttons: "randomize odds" and "randomize prizes". "Randomize games" still exists.
[*]Object menu stays open when opening designer tool.
[*]Allow clicking directly onto patrol points to move them.
[*]Adjust main menu layout to make tutorial button more visible.
[*]Show net and gross profit for objects and zones. Gross profit excludes the construction cost, which made the original profit value look confusing.
[*]Room rating score replaced with a 1-5 star rating.
[*]Staff scheduler has been improved so that you can now directly change the times of each row. It has been re-arranged to be a little more intuitive.
[*]"Add Schedule Row" button now replaces the number of workers instead of adding or subtracting.
[*]Right clicking the schedule painter reduces the workers by 1 instead of setting to 0.
[*]Customize clone tool options! For example, you can choose to ignore walls, floors, and different object types.
[*]In the build menu, split up bedroom and private bathroom objects into two tags.
[*]Some color tweaks to the build menu.
[*]Better feedback on price satisfaction of facilities and items.
[*]Clicking on pit boss office, garbage, bar, and the vault now has a shortcut to the patrols screen for that staff type.
[*]If your casino has a small population, the game will warn you if guests want to leave due to urgent unmet needs. This is mostly useful for new casinos.
[*]Slot machine UI shows max confidence to play at machines, and how many guests in the casino can play it.
[*]Improved feedback and layout of table game min bets screen.
[*]Add zone selection to the eye dropper tool with shift.
[*]Move tooltip further away when placing objects.
[*]Update community translations.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[*]Fix a case where guests and staff were stuck. Staff now find their way out of most situations automatically, while guests will notify you that they are stuck.
[*]Fix a case where staff would assign tasks that they couldn't reach.
[*]Fix zone income & expenses resetting on loading the game. Data already lost cannot be recovered.
[*]Fix some slot machine video playback issues.
[*]Slot machine videos are affected by the game speed.
[*]Fix fences being visible through walls.
[*]Fix some pathfinding related errors.
[*]Fix hotel UI formatting for rating heading.
[*]Fix table games overflowing with chips never being emptied.
[*]Fix guests and staff being selectable through objects due to a distance sorting issue.
[*]Fix clone tool not rotating freeform wall objects correctly.
[*]Fix clone tool rotating when trying to rotate the camera with middle-mouse drag.
[*]Fix slow criminal running speed when being chased.
[*]Arrested agents have a desire to leave, before they might hang around.
[*]Fix camera sometimes not moving after clicking a notification. You still need to wait for the camera to reach it's destination.
[*]Fix guests getting confused and stuck after a bus stop is moved.
[*]No longer revert wall snapping mode between uses.
[*]Object rotation no longer resets when copying an object or changing the visuals.
[*]Dumpsters can be placed indoors.
[*]Increased requirements for hunger before accessing buffet, generally they should now use the buffet immediately.
[*]Fix a case where janitors did nothing because of an inaccessible trash bag.
[*]The security camera is no longer see through.
[/list]

notes.title: May 10th 2021 Update
notes.content:
Hello, everyone!

The other day we put out a hotfix that included two new slot games: Bison Thrash and Linked Thunder!

We also saw a number of reports with too many guests waiting for buses, and it was actually caused by two issues! The first most obvious one was that the bus was not filling up to capacity. The second issue was actually caused by guests becoming too frustrated by the new slot games and leaving so soon that the buses couldn't keep up.

It's important to note that we mostly saw this issue on maps with high house advantages, and we recommend having a variety of advantages so that not all guests will leave angrily.

[list][b]Casino Rating Improvements[/b]
[*]The need scores shown when hovering over the guest satisfaction button at the bottom of the screen is now consistent with the average need view scores.
[*]The stats now show number of guests unsatisfied rather than satisfied.
[*]Boredom and frustration more heavily weigh the overall rating compared to other needs.
[*]The current casino ratings for each type are less affected by the ratings of previous days.
[*]Each demographic (gambling, entertainment, business, and hotel) now has it's own casino rating score. These scores individually affect how many will spawn of each type.

[b]Improvements[/b]
[*]Can now build cashier cage windows, hotel desk windows, and theatre box office windows! Let us know what other objects should be wall-placed!
[*]Creating a new profile with the prebuilt map now loads into the world view.
[*]Rename already owned plots in the world view!
[*]Allow setting the "empty machines" rate in the cash distribution screen to 10%. This isn't the most optimal, but it might be useful in some situations.
[*]All maps have doubled bus frequency. A map with a 30 minute frequency will now only have a 15 minute wait.
[*]Bus capacity increased to 85 from 75.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[*]Fix research not progressing on saves that already had the issue.
[*]Fix buses sometimes not filling up to max capacity. They also start filling up the moment that guests leave the bus.
[*]Fix frustration effect from slot games with low or even moderate popularity having too high effect on guests.
[*]Fix error in world view camera controller.
[*]Sleeping guests no longer count towards crowd audio. Hotel levels should be quieter.
[/list]

[list][h2]Audio Improvements[/h2]
[*]New crowd effects! You will hear guests as parts of your casino get busier!
[*]New city traffic sound effect in the world overview.
[*]Improvements to many sound effects that could not be heard before.
[*]Daytime and night time ambience effect when zoomed out of the casino.

[h2]Slot Machine Games[/h2]
[*]Each slot game has an installation fee, while the commission fee has been replaced with a daily license fee.
[*]Games change popularity over time, and not all guests like every game type.
[*]Adjustments made to the minimum gambling confidence, and added a new maximum confidence. The minimum is still based on the play cost, and the higher this is, the confidence they require to try it. However, the maximum is based on the jackpot prize. If a gambler is feeling too confident, they will no longer have an interest in lower prizes.
[*]Starting gambler confidence is even more affected by their initial wealth level.
[*]Increase gambling attraction for bingo. It is still generally an entertainment attraction.

[h2]General Improvements[/h2]
[*]Replaced the dropoff and pickups zone with a bus stop and car stop! Move them far apart to improve traffic flow. These can not be built from the build menu because they already exist and can never be deleted.
[*]You can now place two new fence types with the fence tool, including the table game rope fence!
[*]Lights in the surrounding city now turn off during the day.
[*]Garbage truck is called automatically (if researched instant transport) when the zone is full.
[*]Staff doors no longer have negative environment effect.
[*]Improved directionality of slot machine sound effects.
[*]Optimizations to the simulation.
[*]After watching a show, guests now clap at slightly random times.
[*]Move card payment fees research to technology tab.

[*]Show an error when a public zone is part of a private bedroom/dressing room locked off area.
[*]The designer menu has been enlarged to accommodate more space for additional buttons for each tab. Navigation is generally better.
[*]When placing slot machines, you can select their game type in advance or select randomize.
[*]New graph screen to see the changes in the slot machine market over time.
[*]Add clone tool shortcut to the toolbar and replace the icon.
[*]Hover over a staff member to see a brief description of their current job. It's basically to make debugging behaviours easier, but we might make it permanent in future.
[*]Improve the colors and layout of the main menu load game window.
[*]Update community translations.

[*]Fix streetlights being invisible.
[*]Fix references to "Retail Worker" with "Drinks Server" in the tutorial.
[*]Fix litter being dropped in the air.
[*]Fix light distances not updating when the camera is following a person.
[*]Fix camera height not being correct when following a person switching floors.
[*]Hide green selection box when following a person.
[*]Fix thieves disguised as janitors getting stuck at staff elevators.

[*]Fix a case where humans get stuck at staircases and elevators.
[*]Fix zone finance history sometimes not showing.
[*]Floors now cast appropriate shadows.
[*]Fix housekeeping getting stuck because of an inconsistency between what they think is the garbage zone capacity and actual capacity, causing them to get in a loop.
[*]Fix broken zone assignments when cloning them. You may have to remove old effected zones first for the fix to work.
[*]Allow the hand sanitizer to be placed outside for outside gyms.
[*]Fix ctrl-select wallpaper double-charging for the first wallpaper selected.
[*]Fix one of the new plants not changing color.
[*]Remove unnecessary environment effects from various objects, which makes more sense and improves performance.
[*]Fix some objects in the tutorial losing their textures when trying to move them.
[*]Fix world view UI not scaling correctly.
[*]Fix theatre user interface not showing more than 4 stages.
[*]Drink servers now face guests when serving them.
[*]Fix supply crates and bedding being dropped on the other side of walls if no space in the nearby cells. Only if the area is really full then it might have to.
[*]Fix drink servers not choosing the nearest bar to replenish their stock.
[*]Fix hedges not fitting correctly when rotated by the player.
[*]Fix owned plots saying they had no structure in the world UI.
[/list]

notes.title: MAJOR March Update!
notes.content:
[h2]Introduction[/h2]
Hello everyone! We're very excited to bring you a load of new features! The list of new features is so long we've written it as a separate list to the changelog.

As you can imagine, lots of new features means lots of text that needs translating. Please consider volunteering to translate text here! [url=https://www.localizor.com/simcasino]https://www.localizor.com/simcasino[/url]

[h2]Tutorials![/h2]
We have introduced 5 new tutorials: Camera Controls, Building & Decorating, A Successful Casino, Managing Staff & Crime, and lastly, Inventory & Finances.

[h2]Electricity[/h2]
A lot of objects now have electricity running costs. During the day, your solar panels can generate electricity to offset the cost. There's an additional boost to their effectiveness at midday. Spare electricity is not sold.

[h2]Ventilation[/h2]
We've added a simple temperature system to the game. It gets hotter during the day and in summer, and colder at night and in winter. As you grow the casino and increase the number of guests and staff, their body heat increases temperature too.

If guests feel too hot, you will see a notification at the bottom of the screen. Guests will slowly get frustrated and thirsty, so you might be able to use it to your advantage! It is currently a slow effect, so if it only happens on a peak hot day it won't be too bad.

Ventilators can be built anywhere on the roof, as we generally wanted to avoid cramping your styles. They only use electricity when they need to cool down the building.

[h2]Research Progression[/h2]
We're aware that you can unlock things too fast in the game. We need to be cautious not to be too forceful, for example, if a player loads a new map and genuinely just wants to build a cheap motel. So we've tried to find a balance that does slow a lot of the progress without forcing the player to, for example, only build slot machines.

There are 8 new research levels, and a newly organized research screen. Here are the main ones:

1. The default maximum house advantage has been lowered from 10% to 9%. There are now three research levels: 12%, 15%, and 18%. If you already researched 20% in a previous save, it will default to unlocking 18% so that it doesn't break your entire casino.
2. Various attractions are now locked behind research.
3. Fancy decorations and high-end hotel room objects are also now locked.

[h2]Map and Wealth Rebalancing[/h2]
Low wealth maps have a chance of spawning some high wealth guests, and high wealth guests arrive with even higher gambling confidence than before. Demographics distribution has been changed for all maps. Please check the world view screen to see all of the adjustments. Generally, they are much less extreme, and a bit more realistic based on the local area. Finally, taxes are much higher on higher wealth maps.

[h2]Beds![/h2]
Beds now show different sheet models when they are clean, dirty, and used. Yes, guests now sleep under the covers!

You can now adjust the colors of the bed frame, pillows, and sheets separately! We've added a new single bed and 3 new queen beds!

[h2]Better Demolish Tool[/h2]
Firstly, you can now demolish "inside areas" without the tool needing to touch the outside. For example, build a large foundation and then cut out a square in the middle to make a courtyard.

Instead of showing an error for things it cannot remove, the demolish-foundations tool now (generally) just removes everything. We've added a confirm pop-up because of how powerful it is. It removes objects, foundations, walls, wall objects, zones, and flooring. It still deletes one floor at a time.

[h2]Staff Schedule UI[/h2]
You can now directly modify the timetable hours in the staff scheduler. Remove rows or input new values! To add additional timetable hours, click the Add New Shift button!

[h2]Changelog 25th March 2021[/h2]
This changelog excludes the features listed above!
[list][b]Improvements[/b]
[*]Jackpot amount slightly reduces player confidence requirement at slots.
[*]Slowed down gambler confidence growth.
[*]For better performance, you can now disable far away lights in the settings screen. It is more noticeable on large maps.
[*]Improved multi-thread usage for large casinos. Should also fix zone errors taking a long time to update.
[*]Replace default flooring and wall designs with new styles for the prebuilt map.
[*]Floor & Objects removal tool now removes wall objects and fences. It does not remove walls, but we'll try and add that at a later time.
[*]Added some walls to the world map to show separated maps.
[*]Allow storage shelves in delivery zones without an error.
[*]Guest bathrooms can now validate with either showers or baths.
[*]Reduce required sizes for storage zone and vault zone.
[*]Slightly increase required size for conference room.
[*]Fence color defaults to brown instead of white. You can still "lock" a previously used color instead.
[*]Reduce the number of updates that happen at the same time to smoothen out frames at the start of each hour.
[*]Beds can have dirty sheets removed and taken directly to laundry instead of waiting for a free washing machine.
[*]Update community translation files.

[b]UI[/b]
[*]New BG for the bottom UI bar.
[*]The old confidence percent score is now just a decimal number to make it less confusing when it goes over "100%" (which is now just over "100").
[*]Right click to close pop-up human & object windows instead of left click.
[*]Add tooltip warning when new patrol point is floating or blocked by an object.
[*]Added "no" to confirm research selection.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[*]Fix errors caused when construction is happening at the same time guests are deciding where to go.
[*]Fix humans being selectable through the floor on the lower level.
[*]Fix fences showing on different floors on load.
[*]Fix washing up tasks in the kitchen not being started.
[*]Fix chefs not standing in the correct position to wash pots.
[*]Increase the priority of washing utensils.
[*]Fix not updating multiple currency values within a text.
[*]Fix washing machines going into negative numbers of stock.
[*]Fix objects on a higher level sometimes showing when first loading the map. Note: this does not fix floating fences, but changing the floor level will fix it.
[*]Fix a potential cause of the game running out of memory.
[*]Fix highlight-boxes staying vertical when guest lays down to sleep.
[*]Fix cloned pit boss offices not being used. [b]Note:[/b] You may have to rezone them to get them working!
[*]Fix some markers being white.
[*]Fix some animations not resetting correctly on loading a game.
[*]Fix housekeeping brining a clean sheet to a bed before taking away the dirty one.
[*]Fix some bar-stool gaps at two of the bars.
[*]Fix patrol error message position being hidden behind other UI.
[*]Fix a case of stuck vehicles after modifying the map.
[*]Fix mouse-edge scrolling over the UI without a delay. There is now a 2 second delay.
[*]Fix music starting for a couple of seconds when first launching even if it's supposed to be muted.
[*]Separate stats on the bottom UI bar because they were too close together.
[*]Fix a few wall designs that disconnect above doors.
[*]Fix one of the panel wall designs showing the wrong icon.
[*]Fix some world buildings disappearing randomly because of outdated occlusion culling data.
[*]Fix some world buildings looking dark because of the wrong layer set.
[*]Fix a case where windows could not be placed on a wall next to a staircase or escalator just below the roof level.
[*]Fix guests not wandering and instead heading to similar spots, generally looking into walls.
[*]Fix bingo podium staff entry point rotation.
[*]Fix spawn counts for new customers being incorrect, causing some to not turn up.
[*]Fix an error when an object is destroyed during a crate pickup task.
[*]Fights are no longer attempted in elevators and other objects.
[*]Fix an error when bar staff try to serve someone who got up.
[*]Remove wall tool is clamped within 1 cell away of the map edge to fix out of range errors.
[*]Fix wall removal tool not always removing every wall object.
[*]Multiselecting objects to paste schedules no longer includes certain objects that don't use schedules that were incorrectly added.
[*]Fix demolish tool not being visible near roof edges.
[/list]

[*]Fix for error when removing elevator.

notes.title: Announcing New Edge Branch! Update Highlights!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey, happy new year everyone![/h2]

[h3]Edge Announcement[/h3]

Today we're starting a new edge branch for the game. Currently, everyone is on the "default" branch. This means that, from now on, there will only be bug fixes and slightly less frequent updates on default. The less frequent, the better as it means there are less bugs!

Meanwhile, we'll be starting an edge branch that will have new, experimental features and improvements that will be available for those who want to see the latest of what we have to offer and are willing to be patient as we fight the bugs. It will be similar to SimAirport, except we will try and keep pushing fixes to the default branch at the same time [b]and[/b] aim to have the features merged into default more frequently than SimAirport. It will depend on the size and complexity of the updates, but our hope is to avoid 2-3 month long stretches.

[b]This will be invite only to start with[/b], and we will increase the number of invites we send out over time. As Arthur noted in one of the streams, we ended up with something like 80% of players on SimAirport edge, making it basically pointless when a big bug did break out.

Please send your steam name and to us via Email: contact@simcasinogame.com and we'll attempt to contact you with the password for accessing edge!

[*]Build elevator directly into walls. We want to expand this further to include auto-foundations.[/list]

[h3]A Story About Garbage Trucks[/h3]

Thought we would give a little behind the scenes info on our current bug hunting progress. Today we had another save come in for a stuck garbage truck - what was the cause this time? It was because of a thief who tried to find an optimal place to steal from that got very confused about where to look and would not stop looking...

To cut a long story short, it was because the job that assigns the staff tasks (such as "move this garbage bag) got stuck in a thread queue. This queue is what allows us to make expensive code run in the background. In the same queue there was what is effectively a "find steal target" job, which got endlessly stuck because it was forever searching the same sections of the map for an appropriate place to steal from.

We thought we'd share this story for two reasons:
1. Not all issues that look the same might have the same cause, giving the illusion that bugs are repeating themselves.
2. In a complex simulation game, downstream issues can cause all sorts of havoc and can take us a long time to debug.

Anyway, that's all for now. We thank all of you for your support!

[*]Vaults now take into account the actual amount of cash when adding or removing during a delivery, not just the number of money bags.
[*]Armoured trucks are only sent when there is at least a $10,000 difference between the target vault amount and the actual contents.

[b]Bugs[/b]
[*]Fix map adjacent areas sometimes incorrectly being calculated.
[*]Staff will now ignore new tasks that they cannot reach. Once started the task, they are committed even if it later becomes blocked.
[*]Fix issue with guest's AI being "scoped" to their bedroom if they are sleepy but their bed is not accessible, meaning they were stuck.
[*]Fix for functional warnings not always showing. It should be much clearer when a part of an object is inaccessible.
[*]Fix for stuck buffet guests when they run out of things to do in their allocated time.
[*]Guests no longer buy access to a buffet when it is missing food (if they are hungry) or drinks (if they are thirsty).
[*]Fix zig-zag path following when walking.
[*]Fix for zone overlay not loading correct transparency setting.
[*]Fix for housekeeping getting stuck trying to reach garbage bags under dumpsters.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfixes #2
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone![/h2]

We'll try to keep regular updates less frequent and larger, but due to a number of game breaking issues we're pushing this patch out too. We're sorry to have rushed the previous hotfix a little too quickly. It turns out our earlier patch dealt with some stuck guests, but did not fix enough for it to warrant an update and we should have verified it with more saves. According to our tests of additional saves, this fixes a lot more issues.
[list]
[b]Bugs[/b]
[*]Rooms were not calculating correct "adjacency" to each other, causing humans to think they were stuck. This resolves a stuck garbage truck issue, a series of invalid room errors, stuck guests at buffets and objects, housekeeping not emptying bins, and more!
[*]Fix guests and staff possibly spawning on the edge of the map. This might not fix existing ones, so you may need to move them to pickups.
[*]Guests who are sleepy who have no hotel to go to will leave early.
[*]Fix escalators, pictures, and other objects disappearing after a reload.
[*]Fix fences not being dismantled.
[*]Sleep now impacts customer satisfaction.
[*]Performers will not leave early if their needs are not met.
[/list]

notes.title: The First Patch!
notes.content:
[h2]First Major Patch![/h2]

Wow, it's incredible how quickly these last 24-hours since release have gone by!  We hope you've been enjoying SimCasino so far, despite the bugs, but we hope this first update sets the pace & gets the dice rolling in the right direction! 

[h3]Today's Patch[/h3]
Our biggest change from today is...  a top-down overhaul of the "path-following" systems -- these control the walking & collisions (local avoidance) between agents and objects, walls, etc! It's been quite a busy day for us, and truthfully I think we even doubted that we'd have deploy-worthy progress on the pathfinding issues today.  We're cautiously & optimistically hopeful that you're going to see some substantial improvements with human movement with this patch!  :)

That said, we're going to have plenty of sprints -- but on the whole, this is a marathon, and there's still plenty of work to be done.  As always, we'll be right back at it tomorrow, answering questions on the forums and working through bug reports, working to bring you the [i]next[/i] SimCasino update.  :)

[h3]Coming Up in the Short Term[/h3]
[olist]
[*]Dev Live-Stream this weekend!  Stay tuned for the date/time announcement.
[*]The 'Official Roadmap' that we often refer to, you can expect it to be released this week.
[*]Focus is bug-fixes until things are cleaned up;  we'll then begin with the content & systems.
[/olist]

[h3]Patch Notes - November 23, 2020![/h3]
[list]
[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[*]Guest ATM withdrawal income renamed to Bank Reimbursement for ATM Withdrawal.
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[*]Guest AI will no longer leave their rooms [i]while naked[/i].
[*]Fix humans getting stuck, like glue.
[*]Fix staff access points on beds.
[*]Fix rename schedule input field not having the currently named schedule filled in.
[*]Fix staff sometimes being added twice, who then need to leave early.
[*]Fix for some staff rarely being sent home early.
[*]Guests are now much quicker at leaving when the casino is closed.
[*]Fix guests abandoning certain tasks when reloading the game.
[*]Fix for guests being unable to access certain objects because they are surrounded by (valid) walls or obstacles.
[*]Fix humans getting stuck on a staircase.
[*]Made the hotel validator thread-safe, which should fix some hotel quirks.
[*]Save fix for an invisible wall being left behind.
[*]Fix for wall dismantle removing wrong wall objects.
[/list]

[h2]Thank You![/h2]
We want to thank everyone for your support thus far, we know there are plenty of quirks & faults to be found, but the outpouring of support and the collective shared vision for what SImCasino can be is incredible, and we appreciate it so much.  We'll continue doing everything we can to build the best gameplay experience we possibly can, and we'll be here working & collaborating with you on a daily basis -- and it's really our favorite part of the process, we wouldn't want it to be any other way.   [b]Thank you!![/b]


[b]-The LVGameDev Team[/b]
